stories.title: Security forces respond to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban along Kurram border: state media
stories.brief: Security forces have responded to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban forces along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Upper Kurram, state broadcaster PTV News reported on Saturday.

stories.title: Several Afghan Taliban posts destroyed as Pakistan responds to Kurram border firing: state media
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army responded to unprovoked firing by the Afghan Taliban in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Upper Kurram and Ghozgarhi, with several Taliban personnel reportedly killed in the retaliatory action, state media reported on Saturday.

stories.title: Any miscalculation by adversaries will draw 'response beyond imagination', warns CNSC Gen Aamer Raza
stories.brief: Also read: Pakistan Army cadet shines at Australian Royal Military College: ISPR “Our valiant officers and brave soldiers have willingly laid down their lives in the line of duty, preserving our honour without a shred of compromise,” he said.

stories.title: Morris wins omnium gold for Great Britain
stories.brief: Great Britain's Anna Morris wins gold in the women's omnium at the Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai.

stories.title: Islamabad ATC summons Islamabad police chief in security breach case against Imaan and Hadi
stories.brief: During the proceedings, the court expressed displeasure over the continued absence of the investigating officer and raised questions about the whereabouts of the case record. Advocate Zafar Khokhar also questioned under which law an investigating officer could take the case record away and leave court proceedings stalled.

stories.title: ATC summons Islamabad IGP in Imaan, Hadi bail case on November 3
stories.brief: The ATC was convening a hearing of a post-arrest bail petition filed by Imaan and Hadi in a case involving protests and interference in official duties in Islamabad.

stories.title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican four days after lung cancer surgery
stories.brief: Pope Leo left the hospital in Rome on Saturday afternoon and returned to the Vatican four days after ‌surgery for lung cancer, an illness that has prompted speculation about how it might affect his 17-month papacy.

stories.title: Attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure pose risks to Pakistan's economic outlook: FinMin Aurangzeb
stories.brief: In an interview on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Aurangzeb said Pakistan had procured enough energy supplies to last through November, and was now planning for the winter months, when household needs typically spike.

stories.title: Egypt’s el-Sisi vows to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
stories.brief: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has vowed to take 'any measure' to defend Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
stories.brief: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.(Image credit: Andrew Medichini)

stories.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
stories.brief: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?
stories.brief: Tesla CEO Elon Musk showcased the vehicle at a facility owned by his SpaceX company, which helped develop the model.

stories.title: Indian airlines barred from using Pakistani airspace until Nov 24 as ban extended
stories.brief: Pakistan has extended its airspace ban for Indian aircraft for another month, until Nov 24, according to a Notice to Airmen (Notam) issued by the Pakistan Airports Authority (PAA).

stories.title: GB's Morris completes hat-trick of golds at Worlds
stories.brief: Britain's Anna Morris completes a hat-trick of gold medals at the Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai.

stories.title: Pakistan extends airspace ban for Indian aircraft until October 23
stories.brief: The authority added that under the extended restriction, no Indian-registered aircraft can use Pakistan's airspace, even if the aircraft has been taken on lease. Read: Iran war deals double blow to Indian airlines already hit by Pakistan airspace ban PAA issued the new NOTAM on the government’s directions.

stories.title: Islamabad ATC rejects police request for physical remand of ex-GB CM Khalid Khurshid
stories.brief: A case was registered against Khurshid, the president of the PTI’s GB chapter, at Aabpara Police Station in connection with the party’s November 26 protest in 2024.

stories.title: Egypt's Sisi seeks parliament's backing to help defend Saudi Arabia if asked
stories.brief: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said on Saturday that Egypt would take any measures necessary to defend Saudi Arabia if asked, ​amid escalating Houthi attacks on the kingdom, and parliament announced ‌an emergency session on Sunday.

stories.title: Morris completes golden hat-trick alongside Boothman in madison
stories.brief: Anna Morris secures a hat-trick of gold medals at the Track Cycling World Championships as she wins the women's madison for Great Britain with Erin Boothman.

stories.title: Govt notifies 48-member Area Representative and Development Council for 12 K-P districts
stories.brief: The federal government on Saturday formally notified the establishment of the 48-member Area Representative and Development Council (ARDC) across 12 districts of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) as the governor consolidated his rule in the province.

stories.title: Two police head constables martyred in attack in Balochistan’s Nasirabad
stories.brief: Two police head constables were martyred when unidentified armed men opened fire on a police patrol in Balochistan’s Nasirabad district on Saturday. Police told The Express Tribune that the incident occurred near Bedar Bridge, where the motorcycle-riding officers were on routine patrol.
